definitions.explanation: A person, especially one of importance or distinction.
A character in a story, play, or film.

notes:
{人物|じんぶつ} can refer to a real person, a fictional character, or someone's qualities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{登場|とうじょう}→登場：13625_toujou⟧{人物|じんぶつ} (character in a story)
- ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧{人物|じんぶつ} (historical figure)
- ⟦{主要|しゅよう}→主要：01649_shuyou⟧{人物|じんぶつ} (main character/person)
- {人物|じんぶつ}{像|ぞう} (portrait, figure study)
- {人物|じんぶつ}⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧ (character evaluation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {人物|じんぶつ}: person of note, character (formal)
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: person (basic, everyday)
- ⟦キャラクター→キャラクター：23518_kyarakutaa⟧: character (borrowed, often for fictional characters)
